name: Give Get Table
job: Show a time trade step by step: when, what the reader gives, what they get back, so the cost of their time sits beside its return.

anatomy.role: Surface card, hairline border, rows split by hairlines
Mono uppercase label step on a tinted bar; the get column head in cyan; the when head is visually hidden
What it costs them, secondary; several items stack as lines

states.name: Phone width
states.note: Below 640px each row stacks; give and get carry text leads.

use_when: A proposal or plan where the reader's time is the real price and should be stated per step.
Each step has both a cost and a return; if one side is empty, it is a list, not this part.
avoid_when: Do not put money here; price belongs in 41 Offer Close.
Do not exceed about five rows; past that it is a plan matrix (52).

data.note: `give[]` is one or more short lines.

access: Marked up with `role=table`, `row`, `rowheader`, `cell` and `columnheader`, so a screen reader announces the columns.
On a phone the give and get cells carry visible text leads; the meaning never rests on colour or position.
Columns use `minmax(0, 1fr)`; text wraps inside the cell.

used_by.name: Louisville proposal (louisville.arcs.care/proposal), page-local today; swap in after the send

gates: `kit_specimen.py --check` (in scripts): this page matches its spec.
`kit_primitive_sync.py --check`: every page that marks this block carries it line for line.
`artifact_wrap_lint.py` and `page_gate.py` on every page that carries it; sweep 360 to 1440, including 700 to 1000.
